metric: candidate outright wins / all scheduled games; draws and unfinished games count as non-wins
acceptanceClock: production monotonic clock and unscaled profiles; predecessor remains 8000ms/200000 nodes/depth12
policy: Freeze the candidate before holdout. Preserve all failed attempts; never tune against held-out records, drop losses or accept before all 40 games finish. Rejecting early is allowed only when completed nonwins exceed 8, making 32/40 impossible. Shortened-clock or scaled-node training never satisfies acceptance.
